subject: Adding data from an excel to a csv to produce survey report

messages.author: dbc36af80a8d3eb2
messages.subject: Adding data from an excel to a csv to produce survey report
parts:
Dear all
Within a large cam trap study I m performing with camtrapR, I want to add some data manually, that I managed to recover from corrupted images.
That is, from the corrupted photos I extracted the station number time, date, sps simply by the info displayed in the image, becauset -as the images are corrupt- I can t extract the metadata using camtrapR. Now I want to add those data to the global analysis, merging them with the valid data. Any idea on how to convert that intoI have in excel to the format required by camtrapR?

In other words: I normally use the .csv produced by “record.table” and “write csv” to then do a “survey report”. Now I have 2 sources of data that I want to use to producea “survey report”: 1) the csv from the good photos+ 2) the data in excel. How do I merge 2 with 1?
Thanks a lot,
best regards

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: [camtrapR] Adding data from an excel to a csv to produce survey report
parts:
Hello,
This is an R question and not specific to camtrapR. 
You may consider using the function bind_rows() from the dplyr package.
The base R function merge() should also work. rbind() would work in theory, bit requires all columns and their order match exactly. The first two options are more lenient.

Nevertheless, make sure that matching columns (species, Station, date/time) have the exact same names in both tables to ensure they are matched correctly.

Best regards
